name: xero-monthly-report
description: Builds the Xero Shoes monthly paid-media review deck from Triple Whale and Google Ads

scripts.check: for f in apps-script/*.gs; do cp "$f" "/tmp/$(basename $f .gs).js" && node --check "/tmp/$(basename $f .gs).js" || exit 1; done && node --check google-ads-script/engine-report.js && node --check tools/harness.js && echo 'syntax OK'
